hullFront.note: Hull front panel — Wikinger Soviet skin (00fb732f48ee4f66ab79d8f52cd98e14) shows white Soviet stars + Cyrillic text (regiment name + number) on hull glacis/front panels in upper-left atlas region. This rect is the correct hull-front emblem zone matching T-34/76 convention. Annotated PNG at artifacts/badge-rects/t34_85.png.
